svg.title: From uncertain failures to evidence-backed repairs
svg.desc: Problem fingerprint branches into local recall and external research, then evidence mapping, local repair and tests, review and evidence packaging. Failed checks feed back into research.

text.font-family: Inter, Arial, 'Noto Sans CJK SC', 'Microsoft YaHei', 'PingFang SC', sans-serif
